ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Plant life is fed by what source in this food chain?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The title in the figure is “Food Chains in Tundra”. At the far left of each row of the three food chains there is a yellow sun icon, and arrows point from the sun to plant-like organisms, such as grass, lichen, or moss, and then continue pointing to animals and mushrooms, etc. Reasoning: The arrows in the food chain indicate the direction of energy or food source. Because the arrows point from the sun to plant life, the energy source of plant life is sunlight.
